calc_items.title: Dextrose % from GIR (Day 10 repair)
calc_items.question: A neonate needs a GIR of 7 mg/kg/min at a total fluid of 120 mL/kg/day. What dextrose concentration (%) is required?

calc_items.title: F-75 daily volume (Day 14 repair)
calc_items.question: F-75 is ordered at 130 mL/kg/day for a 7.5-kg child. Calculate the daily volume.

calc_items.title: F-100 energy equivalent (Day 14 repair)
calc_items.question: A 9-kg child has a theoretical energy target of 150 kcal/kg/day with F-100 at 1 kcal/mL. Calculate the kcal/day and the equivalent volume.
calc_items.working: 9 × 150 = 1350 kcal/day ≡ 1350 mL/day at 1 kcal/mL; not an unconditional fluid prescription.

calc_items.title: D10 bolus volume and glucose (Day 14 repair)
calc_items.question: D10 is given at 5 mL/kg to a 6-kg child. Calculate the bolus volume and the glucose mass.
calc_items.working: 6 × 5 = 30 mL; D10 = 0.1 g/mL, so 30 × 0.1 = 3 g glucose

calc_items.title: First adenosine dose
calc_items.question: Using the AHA dosing, calculate the first adenosine dose for an 18-kg child with stable SVT.
calc_items.working: 0.1 mg/kg × 18 kg = 1.8 mg (first dose; maximum 6 mg)

calc_items.title: Second adenosine dose
calc_items.question: Using the AHA dosing, calculate the second adenosine dose for a 32-kg child.
calc_items.working: 0.2 mg/kg × 32 kg = 6.4 mg (second dose; maximum 12 mg)

calc_items.title: First defibrillation energy
calc_items.question: Calculate the first defibrillation shock energy (teaching dose) for a 22-kg child in VF.

calc_items.title: QTc (Bazett)
calc_items.question: QT is 0.36 s and the RR interval is 0.81 s. Calculate the QTc using Bazett's formula.
